senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (शवति)
1 To go or approach.
2 To alter, to change.

mn. (-वः-वं)
A dead body, a corpse.
n. (-वं)
Water.
E.
शव to go, अच् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
1 Tawny, (of that colour.)
2 Relating to the purification of defilement from the contact or consanguinity of a corpse, &c.
3 Relating to a dead body.
m. (-वः)
1 Tawny, (the colour.)
2 The young of any animal, see the next.
E.
शष a dead body, and अण् aff.; or शव to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-वः)
1 Sacrifice, oblation.
2 Offspring, progeny.
3 The sun.
4 The moon.
n. (-वं)
1 Water.
2 The juice or honey of flowers.
3 Sprinkling the juice of the acid Asclepias.
E.
षू to bear, &c., aff. अप्.

m. (-म्यः)
A dog.
E.
शव a corpse, and काम्य desirous.

m. (-हः)
Burning a corpse.
E.
शव, and दाह burning.

m. (-ही)
A person who burns a corpse.
E.
शव, and दाहिन् who burns.

n. (-नं)
The litter or bed on which a dead body is carried to be burnt.
E.
शव a corpse, and यान a vehicle.

m. (-रः)
1 A barbarian, one inhabiting the mountainous districts of India, and wearing the feathers of the peacock, &c. as decorations.
2 Water.
3 A name of ŚIVA.
4 The hand.
5 A Śāstra, a sacred treatise.
E.
शव a corpse, रा to take, aff. क and टाप्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Low, vile.
m. (-रः)
1 Fault, offence.
2 Sin, wickedness.
3 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosus.)
f. (-री)
1 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
2 A sort of Prākṛta, that spoken by barbarians.
E.
शवर a man of low or degraded caste, and अण् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Water.
2 A name of ŚIVA. More properly. शवर, q. v.

m. (-रः)
1 The Lodh tree.
2 Sin, crime.
3 Fault, offence.
E.
see शावर.

m. (-लः)
A sort of Lodh.

m. (-यः)
The abode of an outcaste or low tribe.
E.
शवर a barbarian, and आलय abode.

m. (-सः)
The abode of an outcaste or barbarous tribe.
E.
शवर a barbarian, and आवास abode.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Variegated, of a variegated colour.
2 Imitative.
3 Articulate.
m. (-लः)
A variegated colour.
f. (-ला-ली)
1 A brindled cow.
2 The cow of plenty, KĀMADHENU.
n. (-लं)
1 Water.
2 A religious observance peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E.
शव to curse, कल aff., and प changed to व.

f. (-ता)
Variegation, variety of colour.
E.
शवल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शवलत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Variegated.
E.
शवल, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

n. (-नं)
A mystical and magical ceremony performed with a dead body.
E.
शव, and साधन implement.

m. (-नः)
A traveller, (in the dialect of the Vedas.)
n. (-नं)
A cemetery.
E.
शव to go, with असानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The young of any animal.
E.
शाव, and कन् added.

mfn. (-कः-विका-कं)
1 Generative, productive, causing birth, &c.
2 Obstetric, parturient.
f. (-विका)
A midwife.
E.
षू to bear young, causal form, षुन् aff.

n. (-ख्यं)
Copper.
E.
शावर relating to a low race, भेद class, and आख्य appellation.

n. (-चं)
Impurity from the demise of a relation.
E.
शाव, and अशौच impurity.

n. (-नं)
1 Bathing, as a religious exercise, or preparatory to a sacrifice, purificatory ablution in general.
2 A sacrifice in general.
3 Extracting and drinking the juice of the acid Asclepias.
4 Bearing as children, bringing forth young.
E.
षू to bear young, &c., Uṇādi aff. युच्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Natural, (in astronomy) as Sāvana Dina, a natural day, from sunrise to sunrise.
m. (-नः)
1 The conclusion of a sacrifice, the ceremonies by which it is terminated.
2 An employer of priests for a sacrifice.
3 The deity VARUṆA.
4 A month of thirty solar days.
E.
षू to bear or produce, aff. ल्युट्, and अण् added.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Embodied, having a body or form.
E.
स with, वपुस body, टच् aff.

mfn. (-याः-याः-यः)
Contemporary, of similar age or duration.
m. (-याः)
A friend, a contemporary.
f. (-याः)
A woman's female friend.
E.
स for समान equal, like, and वयस् age.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Like, resembling.
2 Of the same tribe or class.
3 Of the same kind, homogeneous.
f. (-र्णा)
A name of CHĀYĀ, one of the wives of the sun.
E.
स for समान like, same, वर्ण tribe, colour, &c.

m. (-र्णः)
The second Manu.
E.
सवर्ण the father of this person, and अञ् aff.

f. (-हा)
A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus Turpethum); also read सुवहा.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Scented, perfumed.
2 Having a dwelling.
E.
स with, वास abode, &c.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Clothed, dressed.
E.
स with, वासम् vesture.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Admitting of an alternative or choice.
2 Doubtful.
E.
स with विकल्प option, कन् added.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Expanded, extended, extensive.
E.
स for सह with, विकाश expansion.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Embodied, having body or form.
2 Meaning, importing.
E.
स with, विग्रह body, &c.

m. (-ता)
The sun.
E.
षू to send or cast, (his rays,) तृच् aff.

m. (-तः)
The constellation Hastā, the thirteenth of the lunar asterisms.
E.
सवितृ the sun, and दैवत godhead; the sun being the ruling deity of this asterism.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Belonging or relating to the sun.
E.
सवितृ the sun, and ल aff.

n. (-त्रं)
Cause or instrument of production or generation.
E.
षू to bear, aff. इत्र.

m. (-त्रः)
1 A Brahman.
2 ŚIVA.
3 A Vasu or demigod so named.
4 The sun.
5 The embryo or foetus.
f. (-त्री)
1 UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA.
2 The holy verse of the Vedas, the repetition of which forms an essential part of the ceremonies, enjoined to the Brahman, as daily observances: the prayer is personified as the wife of BRAHMĀ, and mystical mother of the Hindu classes, which are regenerated by investiture with the sacrificial string.
3 The wife of SATYAVĀN.
4 A beam of light, a cluster of solar rays.
n. (-त्रं)
The sacrificial string.
E.
सवित्र the sun, and अण् aff. of reference: the prayer is in fact addressed to that luminary, and the deities, &c. are manifestations of the planet or prayer.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating or belonging to the sun.
E.
सवितृ the sun, घ aff.

f. (-त्री)
1 A mother.
2 A cow.
E.
षू to bring forth young, तृच् aff., ङीष् fem. aff.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Learned, wise, versed in science.
E.
स with, विद्या knowledge.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Of the same kind.
E.
स for समान common, same, विघ manner, sort.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Modest, well-behaved.
n. (-यं)
Modestly, respectfully.
E.
स with, विनय propriety.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Wanton, sportive.
E.
स with, विलास sport.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Excellent, superior.
2 Having characteristic qualities.
E.
स with, विशेष excellence.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Distinguished, marked, characterised, individualised by marks or properties.
E.
स with, विशेषण distinguishing property.

ind.
Particularly, excellently.
E.
स with, विशेषतस् especially.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Astonished, surprised.
E.
स for सह with, विस्मय astonishment.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Bearing interest.
E.
स with वृद्धि interest, कन् added.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं).
1 Near, proximate.
2 Ornamented, decorated.
E.
स for समान common, or सह with, and वेश entrance, decoration, &c.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Decorated, dressed.
E.
स for सह with, &c., and वेष entrance or decoration.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Left, left hand.
2 South, southern.
3 Reverse, contrary, backward.
m. (-व्यः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
ष to send, य Uṇādi aff., form irr.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Suffering pain.
E.
स with, व्यथा pain.

m. (-रः)
A reason or argument that is locally incompatible with the conclusion to be drawn from it.
E.
स with, व्यभिचार irrelevancy.

m. (-ची)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
सव्य left, षच to be joined or attached, aff. णिनि; drawing the bow with his left hand, as well as his right.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Cunning, plausible, pretending.
2 Fraudulent.
E.
स with, व्याज pretext.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A charioteer.
E.
सव्ये on the left, and स्थ who stands.

m. (-ष्ठा)
A charioteer.
E.
सव्ये on the left, स्था to stand, ऋन् Uṇādi aff. with the effect of ड, स, and थ changed.

mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
Modest, ashamed.
E.
स with, व्रीडा shame.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Despising, disdainful.
E.
स with अवज्ञा disrespect.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Careful, cautious.
2 Dilligent.
E.
स with, अवधान care.

m. (-र्णिः)
1 The second Manu.
2 A name applied to the 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th Menus, or Brahma Sāvarṇi, Dakṣa Sāvarṇi, &c.
E.
सवर्ण, and इञ् aff.

n. (-क्ष्यं)
Skin.

n. (-र्ण्यं)
Identity of caste, class, &c.
E.
सवर्ण, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Imperfect, incomplete.
2 Leaving a residue or remainder.
E.
स with, अवशेष remains.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Despising, disdaining.
E.
स with, अवहेल disrespect.

m. (-तः)
A man of the three first classes, not invested at the proper time with the sacrificial cord.
E.
सावित्री, and पतित fallen.

m. (-ष्टः)
A man of the three first classes, not invested with the string at the proper season.
E.
सावित्री, and परिभ्रष्ट broken.

n. (-त्रं)
The sacrificial or characteristic cord of the three first classes.
E.
साविची the sacred text, (the repetition of which forms part of the ceremony of investiture,) and सूत्र a thread.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Proud, haughty.
2 Manifest.
E.
स with, आविष्कार manifestation.
